questions.title: Which country will the Trump administration target in its first invocation of Section 338 tariff powers by August 18, 2026?
questions.background: Section 338 of the Tariff Act of 1930 authorizes U.S. tariffs in response to discriminatory treatment of American commerce.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Resolve to the country whose exports are targeted by the Trump administration's first invocation of Section 338 of the Tariff Act of 1930, announced on or before August 18, 2026. An announced tariff measure counts even if its effective date has not yet arrived. Use official U.S. announcements or contemporaneous reporting confirming the invocation. Resolution Date : 2026-08-18 Accepted Answer Format : Answer with the country's common English name.
questions.current_reasoning: No Section 338 invocation has been announced through 2026-07-14 ahead of the July 24 expiration of Section 122 global tariffs, but July 10-14 trade developments introduce South Korea as a major Section 338 contender while easing India and France. South Korea enters at #3 (0.11, replacing France from the top 5): following the House Judiciary Committee's July 2 report ('South Korea's Discriminatory Attacks on American-Owned Businesses') over Coupang, White House charges of 'discriminatory targeting of US technology companies,' and US State Department criticism of South Korea's revised Network Act (effective July 7)—all matching Section 338's literal 'discriminatory treatment of American commerce' trigger—Seoul abruptly recalled Ambassador Kang Kyung-wha on July 14 for July 15-19 consultations explicitly tied to Coupang and post-July 24 Section 122 tariff changes (partially tempered by a Seoul court granting Coupang an FTC injunction on July 14). Canada stays #1 (0.24) given its exclusion from March Section 301 probes and USMCA sidelining while US-Mexico talks open the week of July 20. China nudges up (0.15 -> 0.16) after July 14 customs data showed June exports surging +27% YoY and a $125.6B trade surplus following failed May Beijing talks. Brazil trims slightly (0.10 -> 0.09) because Valor International (July 10) confirms two cumulative Section 301 tariffs totaling 37.5% (25% decision due July 15 + 12.5% forced labor) already serve as USTR's primary tool. India trims (0.08 -> 0.06) after Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal praised 'fantastic meetings' with USTR Greer on July 13 targeting a fall trade deal alongside Section 301 hearings. Leaving 34% tail mass for France, UK, Mexico, Japan, Germany, Vietnam, and others.

questions.title: Who will succeed Oleksandr Syrskii as Ukraine's top military commander?
questions.background: Oleksandr Syrskii leads Ukraine's armed forces during the war against Russia.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : An official announcement by Ukraine's presidency or reliable contemporaneous reporting, including Al Jazeera. Resolution Condition : Resolve when Ukraine's president formally appoints a successor to Oleksandr Syrskii as the country's top military commander. Temporary or acting appointments do not count unless confirmed as permanent. Accepted Answer Format : The successor's full name.
questions.current_reasoning: Major 2026-07-16 breaking developments in Kyiv (France 24, Hromadske, Reuters/Straits Times, CBS, Moscow Times): following Defense Minister Mykhailo Fedorov's dismissal, rare wartime street protests erupted across Ukrainian cities, Air Force deputy commander Pavlo Yelizarov resigned in protest, and Zelenskyy paused confirming a Defense Minister replacement while acknowledging the rift. At an explosive July 16 Kyiv press conference, Fedorov revealed he had petitioned Zelenskyy to replace BOTH Commander-in-Chief Oleksandr Syrskyi AND Chief of the General Staff Andrii Hnatov to pursue asymmetric warfare—directly damaging Hnatov's succession odds (0.24 -> 0.17), since dismissing Syrskyi amid modernization protests only to promote Hnatov would undercut the reset, leaving Hnatov viable mainly in an institutional continuity scenario. Conversely, Gen. Mykhailo Drapatyi rises sharply (0.32 -> 0.39): Fedorov explicitly cited Drapatyi at the press conference as a victim of Syrskyi's 'isolation and toxic treatment of those who are developing,' and Drapatyi publicly voiced support for Fedorov (Reuters/Straits Times), cementing him as the #1 reformist consensus choice—though capped below 0.45 because publicly backing Fedorov could make Zelenskyy wary of a politically independent figure. Pavlo Palisa climbs (0.11 -> 0.15) as the premier compromise modernizer inside the Presidential Office trusted by Zelenskyy and untainted by either Syrskyi's Soviet-style reputation or Fedorov's public challenge. Ground Forces chief Hennadii Shapovalov holds at 0.08 and Deputy Defense Minister Yevhen Moisiuk trims slightly (0.06 -> 0.05), reserving 16% residual mass for other senior commanders (e.g., Oleh Apostol, Ihor Skybiuk, Andrii Biletskyi, Robert Brovdi).

questions.title: If Typhoon Noul makes landfall in mainland China during July 2026, in which province will it do so?
questions.background: Landfall refers to the cyclone's centre crossing the coastline, rather than areas experiencing its wind or rain.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : China's National Meteorological Centre's official landfall report, including reliable news coverage quoting that report. Resolution : Resolve to the province containing the reported location of Typhoon Noul's mainland China landfall during July 2026. Accepted Answer Format : The province's name.
questions.current_reasoning: 2026-07-15 update: Yesterday's forecast spiked Guangdong (0.29 -> 0.38) and Guangxi (0.04 -> 0.06) on a ~20% chance that the 55 km/h tropical depression located in the vicinity of Guangdong at 3 PM PHT July 14 (moving WNW at 20 km/h) would briefly reach Tropical Storm Noul status before moving inland. With 24+ hours elapsed by July 15 and zero JMA/CMA/PAGASA or regional press reports naming Noul—consistent with PAGASA's July 14 forecast that the system would weaken back into an LPA over mainland China—the immediate Guangdong TD probability drops from ~20% to ~5% (reporting-lag residual). Re-centering ~95% weight onto late-July mainland China landfall climatology under an active Western Pacific subtropical ridge and developing El Nino (with Typhoon Bavi having struck Zhejiang July 11-12) pulls Guangdong back (0.38 -> 0.33) and trims Guangxi (0.06 -> 0.05) while lifting Fujian (0.21 -> 0.25) and Zhejiang (0.19 -> 0.20), holding Hainan at 0.10 and leaving 7% residual for Shandong/Jiangsu/Shanghai/Liaoning.

questions.title: Which Indian state will have the highest reported death toll from monsoon floods and landslides as of August 5, 2026?
questions.background: India's annual monsoon can cause fatal floods and landslides across multiple states.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Resolve to the Indian state with the highest reported cumulative death toll from monsoon floods and landslides since July 1, 2026, according to official data cited in news reporting Resolution Date : August 5, 2026 Accepted Answer Format : The state's name
questions.current_reasoning: 2026-07-16 meteorological update from Hindustan Times IMD and agricultural reporting shows a pronounced El Niño-linked break-monsoon synoptic pattern (all-India rainfall 21% below LPA; 53% of districts deficient): (1) IMD Chandigarh director Surender Paul confirmed the monsoon trough has shifted northward toward the Himalayan foothills, increasing rainfall in hilly states while suppressing rain over the Indo-Gangetic plains until at least July 21—directly raising landslide and flash-flood fatality risk in Himachal Pradesh (0.17 -> 0.21) and Uttarakhand (0.09 -> 0.11, rising to #3) while trimming Uttar Pradesh (0.11 -> 0.09); (2) commodity/weather analysis confirms lower rainfall since July 8 across Gujarat and Maharashtra is expected to persist for another 7-10 days (through July 23-26)—sharply cutting Gujarat (0.13 -> 0.09), which already trailed Maharashtra after Surat floodwaters receded July 11 and now has minimal runway left before August 5; (3) Maharashtra stays #1 (0.32 -> 0.31) on its already-banked early-July cumulative lead (~35-40+ fatalities) amid a broadly deficient monsoon, while surging Nepal-fed rivers in North Bihar (July 15), >200mm rain in Puri, Odisha (July 16), heavy West Bengal rain forecasts through July 22, and an anticipated Bay of Bengal low-pressure system next week nudge residual tail mass up to 19% (Bihar, Assam, West Bengal, J&K, Kerala, Odisha).

questions.title: Who will score India's first half-century in the July 2026 Twenty20 international series against Zimbabwe?
questions.background: A half-century in cricket is an individual score of at least 50 runs in one innings.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Resolve to the first Indian batter to reach 50 runs in an innings during the July 2026 men's Twenty20 international series against Zimbabwe, according to official match scorecards and contemporaneous match reports. Resolution Date : 2026-07-23 Accepted Answer Format : Answer with the batter's full name.
questions.current_reasoning: Major July 7-14 batting form and lineup update ahead of the July 23 Zimbabwe T20I series (Hindustan Times July 12-14, Khaleej Times July 12-13): BCCI's July 12 squad revision replaced only injured bowler Varun Chakaravarthy with Ravi Bishnoi, leaving the Zimbabwe batting squad intact. However, India lost 0-4 to England and 0-2 to Ireland, and 15-year-old Vaibhav Sooryavanshi failed in all three England T20Is (42 runs across 3 innings, never crossing 20) before being DROPPED for the 5th T20I in Southampton. July 13-14 reporting notes 'it remains to be seen whether he gets any game time' in Zimbabwe, with maiden call-up right-handed opener Prabhsimran Singh (or promoted WK opener Ishan Kishan) creating ~50-55% risk that Sooryavanshi is benched for the 1st T20I in Harare (when India's first 50 is most likely scored). Cutting Sooryavanshi sharply 0.17 -> 0.11 (#4), elevating captain Shreyas Iyer 0.13 -> 0.16 (#3, cited by HT July 12 as the only Indian batter who looked accomplished in England and guaranteed #3/#4 starter), boosting locked-in opener Abhishek Sharma 0.26 -> 0.28 (prior Harare T20I centurion) and guaranteed top-3 starter Ishan Kishan 0.21 -> 0.23 (world #1 T20I batter, could also open), and holding vice-captain Tilak Varma at 0.10 (guaranteed #4/#5 starter with improved 5th T20I form), leaving 12% residual led by Prabhsimran Singh (~8%), Shivam Dube (~2%), and Rinku Singh (~1.5%).

questions.title: Which European country will declare a national emergency in response to wildfires between July 1 and July 25, 2026?
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Official national government announcements or reliable news reporting published by July 25, 2026. Resolution Condition : Identify the European country whose national government declares a national emergency because of wildfires between July 1 and July 25, 2026. Regional or local emergency declarations alone do not qualify. Accepted Answer Format : The country's commonly used English name.
questions.current_reasoning: 2026-07-16 European wildfire update (Reuters/Straits Times, Al Jazeera, Daily Beast): no new national wildfire emergency has been declared across Europe with 9 days left in the July 1-25 window. Critically, President Emmanuel Macron announced on July 16 that the 2,000+ ha Fontainebleau forest fire south of Paris is now contained (with a volunteer firefighter under investigation for arson) and pivoted to launching a replanting fundraising campaign rather than emergency powers—reducing France (0.08 -> 0.05) given France's very high constitutional bar against declaring national wildfire emergencies despite its severe early drought. Reallocating 0.03 across Portugal (0.28 -> 0.29, already under a mainland state of alert since July 3 with ~30,000 ha burned), Spain (0.20 -> 0.21, ~50,000 ha burned and 13 killed in Almería amid intense criticism of regional handling), and North Macedonia (0.11 -> 0.12, strong July 2024/2025 nationwide state-of-crisis precedent as the third heatwave moves east into the Balkans), while holding Greece (0.14, deploying four new thermal-imaging satellites per July 16 Al Jazeera) and 19% residual tail (Bulgaria, Cyprus, Italy, Albania, Croatia, Montenegro, Turkey).

questions.title: What type of munition will be confirmed destroyed in Syria's first OPCW-verified chemical-weapons destruction operation since 2014?
questions.background: The Organisation for the Prohibition of Chemical Weapons (OPCW) verifies the destruction of chemical weapons and associated munitions.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Resolve to the type of munition identified as destroyed in Syria's first OPCW-verified chemical-munitions destruction operation since 2014, as reported to the UN Security Council by 2026-09-03. Resolution Date : 2026-09-03 Accepted Answer Format : Answer with the specific munition type, excluding its quantity.
questions.current_reasoning: Major OPCW development on 2026-07-09: at its 112th session, the OPCW Executive Council reinstated Syria's voting rights and formally approved a detailed verification plan for the destruction of Category 3 chemical weapons at Al Qutayfah (37 km north of Damascus), alongside facility agreements for the Al Qutayfah and Homs CW storage sites (OPCW press release, AP News July 9). Under the CWC, Category 3 strictly denotes unfilled military chemical munitions and devices—effectively excluding improvised industrial chlorine cylinders (0.06 -> removed) from this first operation and concentrating probability on the two unfilled Assad-era binary munition types highlighted in OPCW's May 27 discovery report: aerial bombs of the Ltamenah/Khan Shaykhun type (0.38 -> 0.42) and rockets of the Ghouta type (0.32 -> 0.34). Artillery shells hold at 0.07, unfilled missile warheads enter at 0.05 reflecting Al Qutayfah's historical missile/CW depot role and Syria's prior Category 3 inventory, mortar shells edge to 0.04, and 8% tail mass covers other specific Category 3 designations or devices.

questions.background: This question concerns James's publicly announced team choice for the upcoming NBA season.

Resolution Date : Resolve when James publicly announces that choice. A completed contract signing or appearance in a game is not required. questions.current_reasoning: Sharp 2026-07-15 prediction-market realignment ($106M+ Kalshi volume) and breaking ESPN Sixers reporting (Delaware News Journal 10:30 AM ET, Kalshi News, CBS News): despite Shams Charania's July 14 note naming Cleveland, Miami, and Philadelphia as LeBron James's core focus, Kalshi (10:30 AM ET July 15) moved to Cleveland 39% (-5%), Golden State 30% (+4%), Miami 14% (-1%), Philadelphia 13% (+3%), and Minnesota 3% (-2%), while Polymarket stood at Cleveland 40%, Golden State 27%, Miami 14%, Philadelphia 12% (+10%), and Minnesota 3%. Meanwhile, ESPN's Dave McMenamin reported Tuesday night that Tyrese Maxey (a Klutch client), Joel Embiid, and newly acquired Jaylen Brown have all been directly recruiting James and that he is taking Philadelphia's pitch 'really seriously' ahead of Thursday July 16 NYC podcast/talk-show tapings (with Kalshi pricing 48% odds of a decision before July 17 and 70% before July 19). Blending live Kalshi/Polymarket consensus with Shams's reporting trims Cleveland Cavaliers 0.42 -> 0.40, lifts Golden State Warriors sharply 0.20 -> 0.27 (#2), cuts Miami Heat 0.21 -> 0.15 (#3), lifts Philadelphia 76ers 0.10 -> 0.13 (#4), and holds Minnesota Timberwolves at 0.03 (2% residual for Nuggets/others).

local_articles.title: LeBron James Calls Jay-Z His ‘Big Brother’ After Taking His Side in His Feud Against Drake
local_articles.snippet: LeBron James has famously referred to himself as a ‘hip-hop historian‘ in the past. He’s teased new tracks from artists long before they released, even executive-producing a 2 Chainz album back in 2019. He’ll share unreleased lyrics from Drake or tell Kendrick Lamar and TDE to release Untitled Unmastered. Jay-Z often goes out of his way to find King James before basketball games he attends. But like anyone involved in hip-hop, now he’s found himself in the middle of a beef. Drake has felt particularly scorned by LeBron James after he showed up to support Kendrick Lamar at The Pop Out in 2024. “I shouldn’t even be shocked to see you in that arena, because you always made your career off of switching teams up,” Drake raps on “Make Them Remember”. “Please stop asking what’s going on with 23 & me, I’m a real n***a, and he’s not, it’s in my DNA.” Videos by VICE Now, Jay-Z has entered the fray
